name: AuNix
summary: Nationwide ADSL + dialup + phone ISP (aunix.com.au, c.2005-08); defunct.

events.details: ADSL, dialup, phone; earliest Wayback capture 14 Jul 2005 (aunix.com.au).

Defunct; aunix.com.au still captured through Dec 2011 but no longer a live retail ISP site. Both current (c. 2008) and proposal (c. 2018) are wrong: AuNix kept selling NBN plans into 2020-21 and its operator's ABN cancelled 1 Oct 2021. retail NBN/ADSL2 site live to Jul 2021; operator ABN cancelled 1 Oct 2021; webmail-only portal by May 2023.

refs.label: The Nov 2018 302 of aunix.com.au → aunix.net.au was a domain migration, not a death — the new WP retail ISP site sold NBN/ADSL plans through at least Aug 2020 (
Operator entity (name shown on the AuNix site) deregistered 1 Oct 2021 — the actual death trigger
By May 2023 the site was reduced to webmail/member-login only — dead by the retail convention; same state today (2026)

events.details: ABN 14 654 198 802 (AUNIX AUSTRALIA PTY LTD, active from 4 Oct 2021, trading as PRINT SHOP NSW, Guildford NSW) is an unrelated later entity, not this ~2005 ISP; previously miscited here.
